member.name: T:APC.UI.Controls.ApcScanBox
member.summary: Barcode input field. After Attach(form) it receives scans wherever focus is on that form. When input is detected as a scan, the focused field is restored to its value before the burst, the code moves here, and Scanned is raised. The scan's Enter is swallowed so it does not press the form's default button (AcceptButton). Feedback happens once after Scanned is handled: success/failure per e.Accepted. A rejected code stays selected in the field so the next scan overwrites it (not cleared). A field that is not attached never raises Scanned (plain input field). Typed text + Enter is not Scanned either (scanner-speed input only) — if manual entry must be accepted, handle KeyDown Enter separately. With several scan fields on one form (mold + employee badge), attach all and give each an Accepts (which codes it takes): a code goes to the field that accepts it (regardless of focus or scan order). A code no field accepts goes to the focused scan field (or the first attached one) and the app rejects it.

member.name: P:APC.UI.Controls.ApcScanBox.Accepts
member.summary: Whether this field takes the code (e.g. c => c.StartsWith("EMP-")). Give one per field when a form has two or more scan fields — a code the focused field does not accept moves to the field on the same form whose Accepts takes it, and that field raises Scanned. null = takes every code that arrives here, but does not take over codes other fields refused (set Accepts for that).
